+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_user_summary(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, {"summary": f"{user['name']} <{user['email']}>"}

diff:
--- a/tests/test_user_summary.py
+++ b/tests/test_user_summary.py
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+from app.api.handlers import handle_user_summary
+
+
+def test_user_summary_ok():
+    assert handle_user_summary({"id": "1"}) == (200, {"summary": "Ada Lovelace <ada@example.com>"})
+
+
+def test_user_summary_other_user():
+    assert handle_user_summary({"id": "3"}) == (200, {"summary": "Grace Hopper <grace@example.com>"})
+
+
+def test_user_summary_non_digit():
+    assert handle_user_summary({"id": "abc"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+def test_user_summary_missing_id():
+    assert handle_user_summary({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+def test_user_summary_non_string_id():
+    assert handle_user_summary({"id": 1}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+def test_user_summary_not_found():
+    assert handle_user_summary({"id": "99"}) == (404, {"error": "not found"})
